tasks.subject: Task 3: Give each domain SME its own namespace
tasks.description:

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/generator/context.ts` (domains mapping), `src/generator/entity-files.ts` (asDomains + render loop)
- Test: `src/generator/instance-template.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- `buildContext` emits a `namespace` on every domain entry
- A domain whose slug matches a namespace uses it; otherwise falls back to namespaces[0]
- Two domains with different namespaces produce different `kb_namespaces`
- Generated SMEs still validate against agent.schema.json

**Verify:** `npx vitest run src/generator/`

**Steps:**
1. Write failing test asserting two SMEs get different kb_namespaces
2. Add namespace to DomainBlock and the context mapping
3. Carry namespace through asDomains; replace firstNamespace in the loop
4. Run tests, commit


tasks.subject: Task 4: Let an instance supply its own catalog
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `loadCatalog()` resolves an instance-level catalog directory, so a repo can define its own namespace preset without adding team-specific content to the framework. Required because `kb.namespaces` is a single_select that throws on unknown values — `custom` is the only selectable escape hatch, and it currently resolves to nothing.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/interview/gates.ts` (loadCatalog), `src/generator/context.ts` (forward the dir)
- Test: `src/catalog/resolve.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- `loadCatalog(dir)` finds a preset defined only in dir
- Entries key by FILENAME STEM, not the `name:` field
- `loadCatalog()` with no argument behaves exactly as before
- A non-existent instance dir is ignored rather than throwing

**Verify:** `npx vitest run src/catalog/ src/interview/ src/generator/`

**Steps:**
1. Write failing test writing custom.yaml with name: arcwright, asserting get('custom') hits and get('arcwright') misses
2. Add optional instanceDir param to loadCatalog
3. Forward extra.instanceCatalogDir from buildContext
4. Run tests, commit

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/interview/gates.ts", "src/generator/context.ts", "src/catalog/resolve.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run src/catalog/ src/interview/ src/generator/", "acceptanceCriteria": ["instance-only preset resolves", "keyed by filename stem", "no-arg behaviour unchanged", "missing dir ignored"], "repo": "team-ai", "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: team-ai remap-namespaces command
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A deterministic command that rewrites `namespace` and `id` front-matter values across a KB from a supplied mapping, producing a reviewable proposal first and only writing when explicitly applied.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/remap/plan.ts`, `src/remap/plan.test.ts`, `src/remap/apply.ts`, `src/remap/apply.test.ts`, `src/commands/remap-namespaces.ts`
- Modify: `src/cli.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Mapping platform->knowledge-graph rewrites namespace AND the id's first segment
- A per-file override beats the namespace rule (this is how one-to-many splits work)
- An unmapped namespace is reported unchanged, never rewritten
- Without --apply nothing is written except the proposal
- --apply rewrites only namespace and id; all other keys and the body are byte-identical
- Applying twice is idempotent
- Unparseable front matter is a conflict, not a crash

**Verify:** `npx vitest run src/remap/`

**Steps:**
1. Write failing planner tests (rewrite, override, unchanged)
2. Implement buildRemapPlan + rewriteId (read-only)
3. Write failing apply tests (preserve-everything-else, idempotent)
4. Implement applyRemapPlan using line-scoped regex on the front-matter block only
5. Add the CLI wrapper and register in cli.ts
6. npm run check, commit

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/remap/plan.ts", "src/remap/apply.ts", "src/commands/remap-namespaces.ts", "src/cli.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run src/remap/", "acceptanceCriteria": ["namespace and id both rewritten", "per-file override wins", "unmapped reported unchanged", "proposal-only by default", "body byte-identical after apply", "idempotent", "bad front matter is a conflict not a crash"], "repo": "team-ai", "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8: Run the namespace migration
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Rewrite `namespace` and `id` across the KB from seven current namespace values to fourteen Arcwright ones, after founder approval of the proposal.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in `acceptanceCriteria` has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:**
- Create: `.team-ai/remap-proposal.yaml`
- Modify: every doc with front matter under `docs/` — front matter only

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- The proposal is presented in plain language and EXPLICITLY approved by the founder BEFORE --apply runs
- After apply, git diff shows changes only on namespace: and id: lines — zero body lines changed
- validate-kb exits 0
- validate-citations exits 0, proving no cross-reference broke
- Re-running the remap reports remap 0 (idempotent)
- No file outside docs/ is modified

**Verify:** `git diff -U0 -- docs/ | grep '^[+-]' | grep -v '^[+-][+-]' | grep -vE '^[+-](namespace|id):'` prints nothing

**Steps:**
1. Generate the proposal
2. Summarise for the founder in plain language — STOP and wait for explicit approval
3. Apply only after approval
4. Prove only two lines changed via the diff grep
5. Run validate-kb and validate-citations
6. Commit

```json:metadata
{"userGate": true, "tags": ["user-gate"], "files": [".team-ai/remap-proposal.yaml", "docs/"], "verifyCommand": "git diff -U0 -- docs/ | grep '^[+-]' | grep -v '^[+-][+-]' | grep -vE '^[+-](namespace|id):'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["founder explicitly approved the proposal before apply", "git diff shows only namespace: and id: line changes", "validate-kb exits 0", "validate-citations exits 0", "re-running reports remap 0", "nothing outside docs/ modified"], "gateScope": "all", "failurePolicy": "stop", "repo": "arcwright", "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 9: Generate the agent topology
tasks.description:

**Files:**

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- 17 agent YAML files exist, each validating against agent.schema.json
- The router has model_tier: none and kind: router
- All 13 specialists have max_hops: 0 and exactly one kb_namespaces entry
- No two specialists share a kb_namespace
- Nothing under docs/agents/ or docs/skills/ is modified (D1)
- Any collision produced a .team-ai-new sibling rather than an overwrite

**Verify:** `node <team-ai>/dist/cli.js doctor --root .` exits 0

**Steps:**
1. init --dir . --answers .team-ai/answers.yaml --on-conflict siblings
2. git status --porcelain docs/agents docs/skills must be empty
3. Review any .team-ai-new siblings by hand — never blind-copy

5. Commit
